plugins.name: OpenDesign
plugins.description: 将 OpenDesign 接入 CPA：管理 API key 与模型映射，提供仅元数据白名单的请求日志与统计、官方模型级覆盖查询、显式单次模型测试，并通过 OpenAI 兼容接口发起流式与非流式请求。 / Connect OpenDesign to CPA with API key and model mapping, metadata-only request logs and statistics, official model coverage checks, an explicit single-shot model test, plus streaming and non-streaming OpenAI-compatible requests.
plugins.author: ruruamour
